card.name: Word starts before dispute/debate words
card.fires_on: The first part of a word or phrase where the next piece would likely spell out dispute, debate or controversy, such as undis-, indis-, deb- or cont-. It also fires on small words before doubt or uncertainty.

modes.label: Un-/in- before disputed
modes.description: Start of undisputed or indisputable, where the rest of the word is about being open to dispute.

modes.label: Debatable and controversy starts
modes.description: Start of debatable or controversy, including inside a URL.
modes.example: It is<< deb>>atable whether all such systems are true AG

modes.label: Words before doubt
modes.description: Small words just before doubt or uncertain wording.
modes.example: if the accuracy of the asthma diagnosis is<< in>> doubt. In these patients, only administer
